svg.aria-label: Pieces after first contact - before and after the cover ties
svg.text: Pieces after first contact - before and after the cover ties
The 30 m/s trunks, the certificate stamped. A piece is 1 kg or more; after = the pieces the live members, the
clusters and the live cover ties hold together. Hover the dots for 0.5 / 1 / 2 / 4 s.
